findings.message: This diff changes plugin code (plugins/specclaw/bin/specclaw-quality-scan and its test) but bumps no version. Bump every plugins/*/.claude-plugin/plugin.json, every plugins/*/.codex-plugin/plugin.json, and every plugins[] entry in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json to the same new version. If an earlier commit on this branch already did that, this finding does not apply.
findings.scenario: Merge the PR → plugins/specclaw ships the changed quality-scan under the old version number → installed users are not offered the ARG_MAX fix, and CI version-sync sees no bump for a plugin-code change.

findings.message: The fix moves all three tables (funcs, dup, clones) to --slurpfile, but the new test only oversizes the function table. The dup and clones paths have no oversized-table row, and neither does a dup-or-clones-only case. Add table-driven rows that oversize each table separately by driving the real path. For example, a fake jscpd that emits many files or clones, plus a fake lizard that emits many functions.
findings.scenario: Revert only the clones change to `--argjson clones "$(tsv_json ...)"` → a repo with tens of thousands of clone pairs hits E2BIG (exit 126) → the 068 test stays green because its fake lizard only inflates funcs.tsv and clones.tsv stays small.
